NumberFormat.description: How a counter writes its number.

thousands.description: Put between each group of three integer digits, as `,`. Default none.

Overflow.description: Whether content past a box's padding box is drawn.

Paint.description:
A color or gradient.

Gradients interpolate premultiplied stops in linear light, so a gradient between two colors

spread.description: What lies beyond the first and last offsets.

subpaths.description:

PathVertex.description:
A path vertex and its tangents. The segment from `a` to `b` is the cubic Bezier through
`a.point`, `a.point + a.out_tangent`, `b.point + b.in_tangent` and `b.point`; zero tangents

in_tangent.description: The curve's second control point from the previous keyframe, relative to this value.

PolystarKind.description: What kind of figure a polystar is.

Out of the flow, placed by `inset`.

ProviderSource.description:
A source whose media an extension provider supplies, not the host's video and image decoders.

A host picks the provider by probing the bytes at import, never by file name, and records
it here so every host opens the source the same way. The engine does not read it.

oneOf.description: A static SVG document, rasterized at its shown size. The source's kind is `image`.

A GIF, animated WebP, or APNG: one cycle of frames, each with its own duration.
Repetition is the clip's. The source's kind is `video`.

A Lottie animation (JSON file or dotLottie package), evaluated at its own frames. The

The dotLottie animation shown, by ID. Absent means the package's first; always absent

oneOf.description: Still images played in order at a fixed rate. The source's kind is `video`.

frames.description:
Each frame's locator, in play order. `null` marks a missing number, allowed only when

missing.description: How a missing frame is shown.

primaries.description:
The primaries of OpenEXR frames' linear RGB, overriding the first frame's
chromaticities. Only for OpenEXR frames.

start_number.description: The number of the first frame, as its file was numbered.

oneOf.description:
A still OpenEXR image: linear-light RGB(A), read at half precision. The source's kind is
`image`.

primaries.description:
The primaries of its linear RGB, overriding the file's chromaticities (BT.709 when the
file has none, as OpenEXR defines).

oneOf.description:
A LaTeX math formula typeset with the bundled STIX Two Math font. The source's kind is
`image`, and it has no locator or fingerprint since it reads no file. A formula that uses
a character the font lacks, such as Hangul in `\text`, does not open.

color.description: The ink where the formula sets no `\color` of its own. White when absent.

display.description:
Display style, with large operators and limits above and below, or text style when
`false`. Display when absent.

font_size.description: Pixels per em, above `0` and at most [`MAX_LATEX_FONT_SIZE`].

latex.description: Math-mode LaTeX without `$` delimiters. Non-empty, at most [`MAX_LATEX_BYTES`] bytes.

oneOf.description: One page of a PDF document. The source's kind is `image`.

background.description: Painted under the page, which is itself transparent. White paper when absent.

page.description: The page shown, counted from `1`, at most [`MAX_PDF_PAGES`]. The first when absent.

RangeShape.description: How selection rises and falls across a Range selector's range.

oneOf.description: Fully selected inside the range, partly at fractional ends.

distance.description: How far a `rise` moves, in pixels. Default half the font size.

duration.description: Seconds each unit takes. Default: the theme's fade length.

stagger.description: Seconds between one unit's start and the next's. Default half the duration.

type.description: How each unit appears: `fade`, or `rise` (fading in while moving up). Default `fade`.

oneOf.description: Words that hold a letter or digit; other characters show throughout.
Laid-out lines.

Rgba.description:
A straight (not premultiplied), sRGB-encoded color with alpha, each component in `0..=1`.

Read from the object or CSS hex (`"#rgb"`, `"#rgba"`, `"#rrggbb"`, `"#rrggbbaa"`, any
case). Always written back as the object, since components need not be multiples of 1/255.

RunState.description: Which runs a Timing selector selects.

oneOf.description: Runs whose time has not started.

One entry of a shapes generator's content tree.

A group is read front to back. Geometry accumulates in its group; a fill or stroke paints
the geometry listed before it in the same group (nested groups included), and a trim cuts

miter_limit.description:
Longest a miter join reaches, as a multiple of half the width, before it is beveled. At
least 1.

ShapeMask.description:
A shape that limits where a clip is visible.

Geometry is in the clip's source space before its transform, so the mask moves with the
clip: `(0, 0)` is the source's top-left, `(1, 1)` its bottom-right. Distances (`feather`,
`corner_radius`, polystar radii) are fractions of that space's shorter side.

feather.description:
Edge softness, non-negative; zero is the outline's antialiased edge. Coverage is blurred
by a Gaussian with standard deviation `0.3125 * feather`, a 10-90% ramp of `0.8 * feather`.

fill_rule.description: Which regions of the outline are inside it.

invert.description: Whether the mask keeps the outside of the shape instead of its inside.

mode.description: How this mask combines with the ones before it.

shape.description: The shape's outline, as a shapes generator's geometry.

ShapeTransform.description:
A group's placement. In pixel space: translate by `position`, rotate, scale, then
translate by minus `anchor`, so `anchor` lands on `position`. The default is identity.

anchor.description: The point of the items that is placed at `position`.

opacity.description:
Opacity of the group as a whole, in `0..=1`; overlapping items are composited first and
faded together.

scale.description: Per-axis scale; 1 leaves the items unscaled. Stroke widths scale with it.

position.description: Where their text's middle lies, as fractions of the canvas, `(0, 0)` top-left.

StreamTopology.description: The streams a media file carries.

video.description: The primary video stream, if there is one.

TextAlign.description: How lines of text align within it.

oneOf.description: Left.
Centred.
Right.

TextAnimator.description: One animator: what it selects, and what it does to what it selects.

TextAnimatorProperties.description:
What an animator does to each character, in proportion to its selection. A property left
out does nothing.

offset.description: Moves the character, in font sizes, +y down.

rotation_degrees.description: Turns the character about its centre, clockwise degrees.

scale.description: Scales the character about its centre; 1 is none. Each axis in `[0, 10]`.

stroke.description: The color every stroke of a fully selected character takes.

tracking.description:
Space added after the character, in font sizes, in `[-0.5, 1]`, as letter spacing adds
it. Lines are not re-broken.

TextBackground.description: A box behind each line of text.

padding.description: Space between the text and the box edge, as a fraction of the font size, in `[0, 2]`.

anyOf.description: Runs in order; their texts joined are the text.

TextContent.description:
A text: one string, or runs whose texts joined are the text.

Written as `"Hello"` or `[{ "text": "Hel" }, { "text": "lo", "class": ["key"] }]`.

oneOf.description: The largest.
Under a title.
Running text.
A cell's label.

TextRun.description: A piece of a text that animators' Class and Timing selectors can pick.

class.description:
Names Class selectors match, each 1 to 64 bytes of `A-Z`, `a-z`, `0-9`, `_` and `-`; at
most [`MAX_RUN_CLASSES`].

text.description:
Non-empty; `\n` starts a line. A grapheme cluster spanning two runs belongs to the run
holding its first byte.

time.description:
When the run is said, from the holder's start (a caption cue's start, or a text
generator's picture time zero).

oneOf.description: A range over the text's units, shaped at its ends, like After Effects' range selector.

based_on.description: What the range counts: characters (the default), non-space characters, words, or lines.

end.description: Where it ends, in the same range. Default 100.

offset.description: Added to start and end, in the same range. Default 0.

shape.description: How selection rises and falls across the range.

Where the range starts: `[-100, 200]` percent, or `[-N, 2N]` units for `N` of
[`MAX_RANGE_INDEX`]. Default 0.

units.description: Whether start, end and offset are percents of the units (the default) or unit indices.

oneOf.description: Characters of timed runs, by the run's time against the current time.

ramp.description: How long the state takes to fade in and out; zero switches.

state.description: Which runs it selects: those not yet said, being said, or said.

sweep.description:
Splits each run's span over its characters in order, sweeping the run character by
character.

oneOf.description: Characters of runs that carry a class.

TextShadow.description: A shadow of a text's glyphs and strokes, behind them.

blur.description:
Blur radius in font sizes, as CSS `text-shadow` takes it (the Gaussian's standard
deviation is half of it). In `[0, 1]` ([`MAX_TEXT_SHADOW_BLUR`]).

offset.description:
Offset in font sizes, +x right, +y down; each component in `[-1, 1]`
([`MAX_TEXT_SHADOW_OFFSET`]).

TextStroke.description: A band around the glyphs and the strokes listed before it, drawn behind them.

width.description:
Band width as a fraction of the font size, positive; a text's strokes sum to at most
[`MAX_TEXT_STROKE_EXTENT`].

TextStyle.description:
How text looks and where it lies, for caption cues or a text [`crate::Generator`].

The font size is a fraction of the canvas's shorter side, the wrapping width a fraction
of the canvas width, and strokes, shadows and padding fractions of the font size. The
engine draws with its host's registered fonts, `font_family` first, then the rest in
fallback order.

Painting is bottom to top as in CSS: background boxes, shadows (last listed lowest),
strokes (outermost lowest), fill, then color glyphs.

align.description: How lines align within the text.

anchor.description:
The point of the text, background included, placed at `position`; `(0.5, 1)` is its
bottom centre.

animators.description:
Per-character motion and color, applied in order, at most [`crate::MAX_TEXT_ANIMATORS`].
Keyframes are in the holder's time (since a caption cue's start, or a text generator's
picture time). They never change line layout.

fill.description:
What paints the glyphs; a color reads as a solid paint. Gradient positions are in the
text's layout box, `(0, 0)` top-left to `(1, 1)` bottom-right, and a radial radius is a
fraction of the box's shorter side. Default solid white.

font_family.description:
The family, as the font's name table gives it (typographic family, else family), matched
ASCII case-insensitively. Missing glyphs and unknown families fall back to the other fonts
in order; `None` uses the fallback order alone. Non-empty, at most
[`MAX_FONT_FAMILY_BYTES`] bytes.

font_size.description:
Font size as a fraction of the canvas's shorter side: positive, at most
[`crate::MAX_CAPTION_FONT_SIZE`] on a caption track and [`MAX_TEXT_GENERATOR_FONT_SIZE`]
in a text generator.

font_size_fit.description:
The range the font size is fitted in so the text fits its box. `None` draws at the
font size as set.

font_weight.description:
The weight in `[1, 1000]` used to match a family's faces, as CSS Fonts 4 matches
`font-weight`. Variable faces draw at it, clamped to their `wght` axis; no face is
synthetically emboldened.

letter_spacing.description:
Space after each character, as a fraction of the font size, in `[-0.5, 1]`, added as CSS
`letter-spacing` does: none after a line's last character or within cursive scripts such
as Arabic. A non-zero value turns optional ligatures off.

line_clamp.description: Where lines are cut and what ends a cut line, as CSS `line-clamp`. `None` cuts nothing.

line_height.description:
Baseline-to-baseline distance in font sizes, in `[0.5, 3]`. Each line's em box (0.8 font
sizes above the baseline, 0.2 below) is centred in a taller line.

max_height.description:
Height the lines' box fits in, as a fraction of the canvas height, in `(0, 1]`, for
`font_size_fit` and `line_clamp`. Text taller than it still draws past it, as CSS
`max-height` lets a box with visible overflow. `None` sets no height.

max_width.description: Width text wraps at, as a fraction of the canvas width, in `(0, 1]`.

position.description: Where on the canvas the text's anchor lies, `(0, 0)` top-left to `(1, 1)` bottom-right.

shadows.description:
Shadows of the glyphs and strokes, the first on top, as CSS `text-shadow` lists them. At
most [`MAX_TEXT_SHADOWS`].

strokes.description:
Bands around the glyphs, innermost first, each outside the one before. At most
[`MAX_TEXT_STROKES`], widths summing to at most [`MAX_TEXT_STROKE_EXTENT`].

TextStylePatch.description:
Changes to a [`TextStyle`]. Each field set replaces the base's whole value (lists are not
merged); a field left out keeps the base's.

background.description: The box behind each line; `null` removes the base's.

font_family.description: The family; `null` draws from the fallback order alone.

UAX #29 words that hold a letter or digit; a CJK ideograph is a word.
Laid-out lines.

fractions of the canvas's shorter side, so a theme looks the same on wide and tall canvases.

base.description: The built-in theme this one changes. Default `clean-dark`.

registers.

margin.description: The space kept clear at the canvas's edges.

panel.description: The boxes behind labels, lower thirds and boxed captions.

still_seconds.description: How long a still shows when nothing says, in seconds.

surface.description: What title and end cards are drawn on.

text_seconds.description: How long a card or text shows when nothing says, in seconds.

transition.description: The transition a slideshow, or a sequence asking for `theme`, puts between children.

ThemeChoice.description: A theme by name, or one built on a named theme.

How a clip plays its source range over its timeline range.

`forward` and `reverse` stretch the source range over the timeline range, so their speed
is the ratio of the two. A loop plays the source range at its own speed for as long as the
timeline range lasts.

From the end of the source range to its start: pictures in reverse order and sound
played backwards.
One source instant for the whole clip, and silence.

oneOf.description: The source range again and again, at its own speed.

mode.description: How each pass follows the one before.

Track.description: A homogeneous visual or audio timeline lane.

audio.description: Bus controls applied to this track's mixed audio.

captions.description: The cues and style of a caption track; present exactly for that kind.

clips.description:
Clips on this track, in authoring order; evaluation sorts by time. A caption track has
none.

id.description: Stable track identity.

kind.description: Controls source compatibility and evaluation behavior.

transitions.description: Explicit transitions between overlapping clips on this track.

ducking.description: Optional sidechain attenuation driven by another track.

effects.description:
Ordered single-input effects applied to the summed clip signal, at most

A mixed audio track.
Timed text, drawn over the tracks before it and under the ones after.

IEC sRGB transfer function.
Perceptual quantizer HDR transfer function.
Hybrid log-gamma HDR transfer function.
